title: Flight delayed
when: Your flight left late or the board shows a new time.

steps.text: Stay calm. A delay is common and you have options.
Keep your airline booking code ready: {{current.next_flight.pnr}}.
Call the airline to check the new time.
Tell your pickup driver you will be late.

options.label: I will miss my next flight

steps.text: Stay near your gate. Gates can change.
Eat and drink something while you wait.
Go to the airline desk and ask for a meal voucher or a hotel for the wait.
Keep every receipt for a travel insurance claim.

branches.label: I will miss my next flight

steps.text: Do not leave the airport. Go straight to the airline desk and ask to be rebooked.
If you are still stuck, tap SOS.
